@Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.postprocess : {α Trace Output : Type} →
  (Trace → Output) → (α → Trace) → α → Output

@Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.postprocess_preserves_kernel : ∀ {α Trace Output : Type} (c : Trace → Output)
  (trace : α → Trace) (first second : α),
  trace first = trace second →
    Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.postprocess c trace first =
      Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.postprocess c trace second

Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.fresh_xor_observation_changes_aperture : ¬Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.Certifies
      Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorAnswer Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorFirst ∧
  Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.Certifies Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorAnswer
    (Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.jointTrace Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorFirst
      Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorSecond)

Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.fresh_xor_pair_not_closed_postprocess : ∀ (c : Bool → Bool × Bool),
  Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.postprocess c Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorFirst ≠
    Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.jointTrace Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorFirst
      Experiments.AbstractLoopsJoint.xorSecond

@Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration : {World State : Type} →
  (ℕ → State → State) → (World → State) → ℕ → World → State

@Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.kernelPairs : {World State : Type} →
  [Fintype World] → [DecidableEq World] → [DecidableEq State] → (World → State) → Finset (World × World)

@Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.finite_scheduled_partition_stabilizes : ∀ {State World : Type}
  [inst : Fintype World] [inst_1 : DecidableEq World] [inst_2 : DecidableEq State] (step : ℕ → State → State)
  (initial : World → State),
  ∃ start,
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      start ≤ n →
        Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.kernelPairs
            (Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial start) =
          Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.kernelPairs
            (Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration step initial n)
